title: Vinyl & CD Mockup Animator
description: Drop your artwork on a vinyl or a CD, turn it in 3D under your own lights, then export a seamless MP4 loop for stories and reels.

title: Shape Drop & Multiply
description: Shapes appear, multiply and fall with real gravity until they fill the frame without overlapping. Use your own SVG or PNG and export a loop.

title: Text & Shape Trace and Fill
description: Type a word or load an SVG logo and watch its outline get drawn like a pen stroke before the color fills in. Export it as a seamless loop.

title: Text Orbit Sphere
description: Wrap any text around a sphere and set its axis and spin. Export a seamless MP4 loop, a PNG frame or standalone HTML code.

title: Compound Blur Controller
description: Type a word or load a PNG, JPG or SVG and move a blur controller over it: the blur travels as far as you set, from a soft halo to the whole frame. Recolor your SVG and export a seamless loop.
